narrative_prose: Silas leaned heavily on the iron workbench, his joints aching as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea sent sympathetic tremors through The First Forge. The air tasted of copper and smelled of burnt ozone, a static charge raising the hairs on his arms. With a nod of mutual understanding, he handed the brass baton to Hector amidst the roaring hum.
summary: Silas readies the forge against the magnetohydrodynamic shear and initiates the baton handoff to Hector.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge hums with the contained fury of a captured star, its brass and iron bulkheads trembling under the strain of the ferrofluid sea's magnetohydrodynamic shear. Thick cables pulse with static charge along the floor, weaving through stations piled high with half-finished tools. Acrid smoke rolls from the primary vent, catching the amber light in mesmerizing swirls as the morning shift begins.
